question: Which number among 11368, 11638, 11863 and 12638 is divisible by 11?
solution:
**Given:**

The numbers = 11368, 11638, 11863 and 12638

**Concept:**

A number divided by 11only when the difference of the sum of the digits at odd positions and sum of the digits at even positions is zero of multiple of 11.

**Calculation:**

For number 11368

⇒ (1 + 3 + 8) - (1 + 6)

⇒ 12 - 7 = 5 

Not divisible by 11

For number 11638

⇒ (1 + 6 + 8) - (1 + 3)

⇒ 15 - 4 = 11

Number 11638 is divisible by 11

For number 11863

⇒ (1 + 8 + 3) - (1 + 6)

⇒ 12 - 7 = 5

This number is not divisible by 11

For number 12638

⇒ (1 + 6 + 8) - (2 + 3)

⇒ 15 - 5 = 10

This number is not divisible by 11

**∴ The required result will be 11638.**

11368:

Even position digits: 1, 6

Sum of odd position digits: 1 + 3 + 8 = 12

Sum of even position digits: 1 + 6 = 7

Difference: 12 - 7 = 5 (not divisible by 11)

12638:

Odd position digits: 1, 6, 8

Even position digits: 2, 3

Sum of odd position digits: 1 + 6 + 8 = 15

Sum of even position digits: 2 + 3 = 5

Difference: 15 - 5 = 10 (not divisible by 11)

11638:

Odd position digits: 1, 6, 8

Even position digits: 1, 3

Sum of odd position digits: 1 + 6 + 8 = 15

Sum of even position digits: 1 + 3 = 4

Difference: 15 - 4 = 11 (divisible by 11)

11863:

Odd position digits: 1, 8, 3

Even position digits: 1, 6

Sum of odd position digits: 1 + 8 + 3 = 12

Sum of even position digits: 1 + 6 = 7

Difference: 12 - 7 = 5 (not divisible by 11)

Therefore, the number among 11368, 11638, 11863, and 12638 that is divisible by 11 is:

**∴ The required result will be 11638.**
